surface: Daily Report and shared field submit shell
exact_symptom: All reports synced control obstructed the sticky submit action on phone/tablet layouts
root_cause: QueueStatusPill used a fixed viewport-bottom offset with no shared contract for FormShell sticky-footer height
smallest_safe_repair: Publish sticky-footer height from FormShell and offset QueueStatusPill above it with safe-area-aware spacing
evidence: Pre-fix 390x844 overlap metrics; post-fix responsive matrix; /app/test_reports/iteration_149.json; /app/test_reports/iteration_151.json

exact_symptom: Public Incident Report submit path returned 401 and appeared to require login
root_cause: Public tile form was wired into authenticated internal /api/incident-cases workspace route instead of a dedicated public write surface
smallest_safe_repair: Add /api/public/incident-cases, keep /api/incident-cases protected, and restore public helper endpoints

exact_symptom: Health failure emails were firing immediately after the 60-minute backup target instead of allowing a realistic operator buffer
root_cause: Backup health classification used the RPO target as the red-alert threshold
smallest_safe_repair: Keep 60-minute warning target but move red-alert / failure-email threshold to 75 minutes via BACKUP_HEALTH_ALERT_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
evidence: /api/admin/system-health backup card detail shows target <= 60m; alert > 75m; focused backend suite

exact_symptom: Daily Report restored prior-day info and then reset around midnight, deleting entered work during 24/7 operations
root_cause: Draft scope was anchored to report_date / project / operator only, so crossing midnight could move the operator onto a new draft key instead of the active in-progress session
smallest_safe_repair: Add active daily draft session anchor persisted per device and auto-restore the matching pending draft session across reload/day rollover
